rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: Asakim... that unit we talked about is coming.
rows.display_text:
「Asakim... that unit we talked about is
coming.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: Will you keep them company today?
rows.display_text: 「Will you keep them company today?」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Going along with his game isn't so bad.
rows.display_text: 「Going along with his game isn't so bad.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: Such a capricious one, you are...
rows.display_text: 「Such a capricious one, you are...」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Not as much as your master, who's set up his toys just to watch the show.
rows.display_text:
「Not as much as your master, who's set
up his toys just to watch the show.」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Now... let the feast begin. I'll have you keep me company for a while.
rows.display_text:
「Now... let the feast begin. I'll have you
keep me company for a while.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: BG acquired...! We're also detecting units other than the escort from our last encounter!
rows.display_text:
「BG acquired...! We're also detecting
units other than the escort from our last
encounter!」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: That bird...!
rows.display_text: 「That bird...!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: The crow from that mission a while back...!
rows.display_text:
「The crow from that mission a while
back...!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: So it was a friend of BG's after all. Now that's a surprise.
rows.display_text:
「So it was a friend of BG's after all.
Now that's a surprise.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All units...! Let's take down the target quick and wrap up this mission!
rows.display_text:
「All units...! Let's take down the target
quick and wrap up this mission!」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Understood! I'll make this unit's last battle count!
rows.display_text:
「Understood! I'll make this unit's last
battle count!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Contract fulfilled! Time to grab that special bonus!
rows.display_text:
「Contract fulfilled! Time to grab that
special bonus!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Watch yourselves, everyone...! Even if it's just a pretext, this is an enemy serious enough to need a special task force.
rows.display_text:
「Careful, everyone...! Pretext or not,
this foe needs a special task force to
handle.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: That machine, BG... we should assume it has strength to match its reputation.
rows.display_text:
「That machine, BG... we should assume it
has strength to match its reputation.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Everyone, beyond this battle, you each have your own goals. Don't forget that.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, beyond this battle, you each
have your own goals. Don't forget that.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Our own goals...
rows.display_text: 「Our own goals...」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: That's why I can't afford to die in a place like this!
rows.display_text:
「That's why I can't afford to die in a
place like this!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: My fight... that would be...!
rows.display_text: （My fight... that would be...!）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Let's go! Focus all attacks on BG!
rows.display_text: 「Let's go! Focus all attacks on BG!」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Did we get it...!?
rows.display_text: 「Did we get it...!?」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: ...This much should do.
rows.display_text: 「...This much should do.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: Understood, Asakim. Then, I'll leave the rest to him...
rows.display_text:
「Understood, Asakim. Then, I'll leave the
rest to him...」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: The target has fallen back.
rows.display_text: 「The target has fallen back.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Should we pursue, Captain!?
rows.display_text: 「Should we pursue, Captain!?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Wait! Something's coming!
rows.display_text: 「Wait! Something's coming!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: What the hell is that!?
rows.display_text: 「What the hell is that!?」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: It's huge...! Bigger than the Psycho Gundam!
rows.display_text:
「It's huge...! Bigger than the Psycho
Gundam!」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Is it a friend of BG's...?
rows.display_text: 「Is it a friend of BG's...?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: That machine... Don't tell me, is that person here...!?
rows.display_text:
（That machine... Don't tell me, is that
person here...!?）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: This is Colonel Neo Roanoke of the New Earth Federation Forces. Please respond.
rows.display_text:
「This is Colonel Neo Roanoke of the New
Earth Federation Forces. Please respond.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: We're currently carrying out a mission. If you intend to interfere, we won't hesitate to attack.
rows.display_text:
「We're currently carrying out a mission.
If you intend to interfere, we won't
hesitate to attack.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Let's hear your name, affiliation, and purpose.
rows.display_text:
「Let's hear your name, affiliation, and
purpose.」

rows.en: ...Very well.
rows.display_text: 「...Very well.」

rows.speaker: Jaboli
rows.en: What is with that voice...!? It goes high, then low -- it's all over the place!
rows.display_text:
「What is with that voice...!? It goes
high, then low -- it's all over the place!」

rows.speaker: Zakki
rows.en: Is he using a voice changer?
rows.display_text: 「Is he using a voice changer?」

rows.en: No name, no affiliation... Nothing binds me.
rows.display_text:
「No name, no affiliation... Nothing binds
me.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Don't screw around! Are you mocking us!?
rows.display_text:
「Don't screw around! Are you mocking
us!?」

rows.en: Take it that way if you like. My purpose is to fight you, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Take it that way if you like. My
purpose is to fight you, after all.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Huh? You dragged out that huge hunk of junk just to pick a fight with us?
rows.display_text:
「Huh? You dragged out that huge hunk
of junk just to pick a fight with us?」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: You think we'd flinch at a bluff like that!? We're Task Force 013!
rows.display_text:
「You think we'd flinch at a bluff like
that!? We're Task Force 013!」

rows.en: Enough talk... I'm here to fight.
rows.display_text: 「Enough talk... I'm here to fight.」

rows.en: As a reward for making it this far, let me give you a gift of overwhelming fear and despair.
rows.display_text:
「As a reward for making it this far, let
me give you a gift of overwhelming fear
and despair.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Don't screw with us!
rows.display_text: 「Don't screw with us!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: We'll make you regret underestimating us -- in the next world!
rows.display_text:
「We'll make you regret underestimating
us -- in the next world!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Guess we have no choice but to fight...
rows.display_text: 「Guess we have no choice but to fight...」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: B-but...
rows.display_text: 「B-but...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Make up your mind, Lowen. He's serious.
rows.display_text: （Make up your mind, Lowen. He's serious.）

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: But, Schlan...! That's the Lemures!
rows.display_text: （But, Schlan...! That's the Lemures!）

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: The mission given to us is to monitor and guide Special Task Force 013.
rows.display_text:
（The mission given to us is to monitor
and guide Special Task Force 013.）

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: We should assume this battle with that machine is also General Edel's doing.
rows.display_text:
（We should assume this battle with that
machine is also General Edel's doing.）

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: General Edel's...?
rows.display_text: （General Edel's...?）

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Then I'll face it with my life on the line!
rows.display_text:
（Then I'll face it with my life on the
line!）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All units, be careful. I don't know who he is, but he seems supremely confident.
rows.display_text:
「All units, be careful. I don't know who
he is, but he seems supremely confident.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'll say it again...! Don't any of you forget your own goals! This is just a point we're passing through!
rows.display_text:
「I'll say it again...! Don't any of you
forget your own goals! This is just a
point we're passing through!」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: True enough. This isn't the stage where we should be staking our lives.
rows.display_text:
（True enough. This isn't the stage where
we should be staking our lives.）

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Dewey's waiting for me...! So I won't lose!
rows.display_text:
（Dewey's waiting for me...! So I won't
lose!）

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Wait for me, Kamille...! I'm not a man who ends here!
rows.display_text:
（Wait for me, Kamille...! I'm not a man
who ends here!）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All units, commence attack! Show them the strength of Special Task Force 013!
rows.display_text:
「All units, commence attack! Show them
the strength of Special Task Force 013!」

rows.en: Yes... that's it. That's exactly why you were all gathered for this battle...
rows.display_text:
（Yes... that's it. That's exactly why you
were all gathered for this battle...）

rows.en: Wh-what the hell...! The Lemures being defeated wasn't part of the plan...! Guess I'll have to redo the design!
rows.display_text:
（Wh-what the hell...! The Lemures being
defeated wasn't part of the plan...! Guess
I'll have to redo the design!）

rows.en: Thank you, all of you in Special Task Force 013. I've gathered some excellent data.
rows.display_text:
（Thank you, all of you in Special Task
Force 013. I've gathered some excellent
data.）

rows.en: This will complete the Lemures. Yes... the Lemures, anyway...
rows.display_text:
（This will complete the Lemures. Yes...
the Lemures, anyway...）

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Did we get it...!?
rows.display_text: 「Did we get it...!?」

rows.en: Heh... heheheh...
rows.display_text: 「Heh... heheheh...」

rows.en: Hahahaha! Ahahahahahahahaha!
rows.display_text: 「Hahahaha! Ahahahahahahahaha!」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: Enemy unit's destruction confirmed. However, the pilot's status -- alive or dead -- is unknown.
rows.display_text:
「Enemy unit's destruction confirmed.
However, the pilot's status -- alive or
dead -- is unknown.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: What the hell was that guy...?
rows.display_text: 「What the hell was that guy...?」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: What did he fight us for...?
rows.display_text: 「What did he fight us for...?」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: That machine's clumsy movements... probably because it was a prototype...
rows.display_text:
（That machine's clumsy movements...
probably because it was a prototype...）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Seems we were made to be his shakedown test partners...
rows.display_text:
（Seems we were made to be his
shakedown test partners...）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: If that's the case, then he's part of the military too, huh...
rows.display_text:
（If that's the case, then he's part of
the military too, huh...）

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Neo...?

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: It's fine, Stella. I was just thinking about something.
rows.display_text:
「It's fine, Stella. I was just thinking
about something.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Captain...! We're receiving a transmission from HQ.
rows.display_text:
「Captain...! We're receiving a transmission
from HQ.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: It seems another unit has captured BG, which our attack left unable to move.
rows.display_text:
「It seems another unit has captured BG,
which our attack left unable to move.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: What!?
rows.display_text: 「What!?」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: Unbelievable. That thing... it could still move.
rows.display_text:
「Unbelievable. That thing... it could still
move.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: That's the enemy we struggled against! There's no way a regular unit could've caught it!
rows.display_text:
「That's the enemy we struggled against!
There's no way a regular unit could've
caught it!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Questioning the truth of it is pointless. If HQ says it's been captured, that's all there is to it.
rows.display_text:
「Questioning the truth of it is
pointless. If HQ says it's been captured,
that's all there is to it.」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: Which means...!?
rows.display_text: 「Which means...!?」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: We're...!

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Mission complete... In other words, our task is done.
rows.display_text:
「Mission complete... In other words, our
task is done.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: ...Can't say I'm happy about it, though.
rows.display_text: 「...Can't say I'm happy about it, though.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Something about this feels wrong...!
rows.display_text: 「Something about this feels wrong...!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Including that unknown we just fought, I'd like a detailed explanation of what's been going on.
rows.display_text:
「Including that unknown we just fought,
I'd like a detailed explanation of what's
been going on.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Unfortunately, that won't be possible.
rows.display_text: 「Unfortunately, that won't be possible.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: What do you mean by that?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean by that?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: With the conclusion of Special Order Code 013, the unit will be disbanded...
rows.display_text:
「With the conclusion of Special Order
Code 013, the unit will be disbanded...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: All operational activity is classified at level AAA, and even our collaborators will be bound to confidentiality, or so I'm told.

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: So it means 'don't go poking your nose in where it doesn't belong,' does it...
rows.display_text:
「So it means 'don't go poking your nose
in where it doesn't belong,' does it...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: That's about right. Even once we're out from under military jurisdiction, we'd best not let our guard down.
rows.display_text:
「That's about right. Even once we're out
from under military jurisdiction, we'd best
not let our guard down.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Thanks for the advice, snake boy. ...Or is that a threat?
rows.display_text:
「Thanks for the advice, snake boy. ...Or
is that a threat?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Take it however you like.
rows.display_text: 「Take it however you like.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Don't care either way... If this unit's getting disbanded, I've got no complaints.
rows.display_text:
「Don't care either way... If this unit's
getting disbanded, I've got no complaints.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Agreed. This means we can finally return to our true battlefield.
rows.display_text:
「Agreed. This means we can finally
return to our true battlefield.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: All units, return to base. This concludes all operations of Special Task Force 013.
rows.display_text:
「All units, return to base. This
concludes all operations of Special Task
Force 013.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: From here on, fight for your own individual purposes.
rows.display_text:
「From here on, fight for your own
individual purposes.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Understood.
rows.display_text: 「Understood.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Special Task Force 013... A worthless unit right to the end.
rows.display_text:
（Special Task Force 013... A worthless
unit right to the end.）

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: These guys... How dare they!
rows.display_text: 「These guys... How dare they!」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Ziene. Leave this to me and fall back.
rows.display_text: 「Ziene. Leave this to me and fall back.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: But...!

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Even if it's a game he set up, there's no need for you to play along with the farce too.
rows.display_text:
「Even if it's a game he set up, there's
no need for you to play along with the
farce too.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: ...Understood. Take care, Asakim.
rows.display_text: 「...Understood. Take care, Asakim.」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: A farce, huh... If we're calling it that, then maybe my very existence is one too.
rows.display_text:
「A farce, huh... If we're calling it that,
then maybe my very existence is one too.」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: That's why I resist... against whatever tries to bind me.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I resist... against whatever
tries to bind me.」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Care to touch the deep darkness that holds me? Is it exactly what you imagined...?
rows.display_text:
「Care to touch the deep darkness that
holds me? Is it exactly what you
imagined...?」

rows.speaker: Asakim
rows.en: Or is it something else entirely? Not that knowing would do you any good.
rows.display_text:
「Or is it something else entirely? Not
that knowing would do you any good.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: I'll test whether you're worthy of being his playmate.
rows.display_text:
「I'll test whether you're worthy of
being his playmate.」

rows.speaker: Ziene
rows.en: Now, here we go. If you can beat us, you'll be promoted to main-event status!
rows.display_text:
「Now, here we go. If you can beat us,
you'll be promoted to main-event status!」

rows.en: So you're this unit's captain.
rows.display_text: 「So you're this unit's captain.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Yeah, that's right. Mission or not, I'll take responsibility for dragging my subordinates into a fight like this...
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, that's right. Mission or not, I'll
take responsibility for dragging my
subordinates into a fight like this...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: By taking you down!
rows.display_text: 「By taking you down!」

rows.en: ...You're an unfree man. With no past of your own, the only meaning you can find in your life is following orders from above.
rows.display_text:
「...You're unfree. With no past, following
orders from above is the only meaning you
find in life.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Say whatever you want! That's how I live my life now!
rows.display_text:
「Say whatever you want! That's how I
live my life now!」

rows.en: All masked men are the same. Bound by mission and duty, making your own lives unfree.
rows.display_text:
「All masked men are the same. Bound by
mission and duty, making your own lives
unfree.」

rows.en: But I'm different. I am a being freed from everything... the very embodiment of absolute freedom.
rows.display_text:
「But I'm different. I am a being freed
from everything... the very embodiment of
absolute freedom.」

rows.en: Sting Oakley, Auel Neider, Stella Loussier... you are all unfortunate.
rows.display_text:
「Sting Oakley, Auel Neider, Stella
Loussier... you are all unfortunate.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Huh...?
You're all bound existences. A life stripped of freedom holds no meaning at all.
rows.display_text:
「You're all bound existences. A life
stripped of freedom holds no meaning at
all.」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Shut up! Shut the hell up!!
rows.display_text: 「Shut up! Shut the hell up!!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: We know that all too well already -- we don't need you to tell us!
rows.display_text:
「We know that all too well already --
we don't need you to tell us!」

rows.en: Kukuku... struggle all you like, then. Against your own fate.
rows.display_text:
「Kukuku... struggle all you like, then.
Against your own fate.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: You... just disappear!
rows.display_text: 「You... just disappear!」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Sting, Stella! We're crushing that guy... no matter what!
rows.display_text:
「Sting, Stella! We're crushing that guy...
no matter what!」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: We're Phantom Pain! We can't afford to lose...! Not if we want to keep living!
rows.display_text:
「We're Phantom Pain! We can't afford to
lose...! Not if we want to keep living!」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: Don't let your guard down, Jerid, Mouar! This guy... he's no ordinary opponent!
rows.display_text:
「Don't let your guard down, Jerid, Mouar!
This guy... he's no ordinary opponent!」

rows.en: Seems you can read the situation. Rather humble, for a Titans member.
rows.display_text:
「Seems you can read the situation.
Rather humble, for a Titans member.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: This world isn't soft enough to let you fight on reputation alone...! I've learned that lesson more times than I'd like!
rows.display_text:
「This world's not soft enough to fight
on reputation alone...! I've learned that
lesson more than I'd like!」

rows.en: But unfortunately, all of that's about to go to waste. Because you all end here.
rows.display_text:
「But unfortunately, all of that's about
to go to waste. Because you all end here.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I'm moving forward! I won't let it end in a place like this!
rows.display_text:
「I'm moving forward! I won't let it end
in a place like this!」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Jerid... I'll protect you...! I'll follow that strong will of yours...!
rows.display_text:
（Jerid... I'll protect you...! I'll follow
that strong will of yours...!）

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: I don't know who the hell you are, but I'll crush anyone who tries to stop me! That's how I live!!
rows.display_text:
「I don't know who the hell you are, but
I'll crush anyone who tries to stop me!
That's how I live!!」

rows.en: Four Murasame... what would you do if I told you I had a way to restore your memories?
rows.display_text:
「Four Murasame... what would you do if I
told you I had a way to restore your
memories?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: ...What?
rows.display_text: 「...What?」

rows.en: If you kneel before me, I might just grant your wish.
rows.display_text:
「If you kneel before me, I might just
grant your wish.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: ...I want proof that I'm alive... I want my memories...
rows.display_text:
「...I want proof that I'm alive... I want
my memories...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: But! I don't want to sell my pride for it! I am... a human being!
rows.display_text:
「But! I don't want to sell my pride for
it! I am... a human being!」

rows.en: Good answer. Trampling it underfoot is exactly what brings me joy.
rows.display_text:
「Good answer. Trampling it underfoot is
exactly what brings me joy.」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Watch yourself, Ensign Rosamia! Take a direct hit and you'll go down in one shot!
rows.display_text:
「Watch yourself, Ensign Rosamia! Take a
direct hit and you'll go down in one shot!」

rows.en: That's right. I am one who brings the heavens crashing down.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. I am one who brings the
heavens crashing down.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: The heavens... crashing down...
rows.display_text: 「The heavens... crashing down...」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Damn him...! Preying on Ensign Rosamia's old wound!
rows.display_text:
「Damn him...! Preying on Ensign Rosamia's
old wound!」

rows.en: Hahaha, how delightful! I'll smash both your heart and your machine!
rows.display_text:
「Hahaha, how delightful! I'll smash both
your heart and your machine!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: You scum! War isn't a stage for satisfying your hobbies!
rows.display_text:
「You scum! War isn't a stage for
satisfying your hobbies!」

rows.en: Is that alright, Asuham Boone? Playing around here instead of chasing the Black Southern Cross?
rows.display_text:
「Is that alright, Asuham Boone? Playing
around here instead of chasing the Black
Southern Cross?」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: This one...! You know about Gain Bijou and me!?
rows.display_text:
「This one...! You know about Gain Bijou
and me!?」

rows.en: I did some digging into you all, and $c too.
rows.display_text:
「I did some digging into you all, and $c
too.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Then you must also know the scale of my burning wrath -- and that anyone who gets in its way receives a fitting punishment!
rows.display_text:
「Then you must know my burning wrath's
scale -- and that anyone in its way is
fittingly punished!」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Get out of my way, clown! I have no time to waste on the likes of you!
rows.display_text:
「Get out of my way, clown! I have no
time to waste on the likes of you!」

rows.en: This movement... so you're the Queen of Overman Battle.
rows.display_text:
「This movement... so you're the Queen of
Overman Battle.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: You know about me...!?
rows.display_text: 「You know about me...!?」

rows.en: In that game, our head-to-head record has you slightly ahead. So, I'll be taking my revenge here.
rows.display_text:
「In that game, our head-to-head record
has you slightly ahead. So, I'll be taking
my revenge here.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: I don't know who you are, but I'm the Queen...!
rows.display_text:
「I don't know who you are, but I'm the
Queen...!」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: I take down every challenger who comes at me! I'm not allowed to lose before I get my fight with the King!
rows.display_text:
「I take down every challenger who comes
at me! I'm not allowed to lose before I
get my fight with the King!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Don't slip up, Enge, Jaboli! If the enemy's big, there's a way to fight that fits!
rows.display_text:
「Don't slip up, Enge, Jaboli! If the
enemy's big, there's a way to fight that
fits!」

rows.en: It's true that even small strength, gathered together, can overcome great strength.
rows.display_text:
「It's true that even small strength,
gathered together, can overcome great
strength.」

rows.en: But think about it -- how many minnows would it take to beat a whale?
rows.display_text:
「But think about it -- how many
minnows would it take to beat a whale?」

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: You're saying you're the whale and we're the minnows!?
rows.display_text:
「You're saying you're the whale and
we're the minnows!?」

rows.speaker: Jaboli
rows.en: T-that can't be...! There's no way we can win, then!
rows.display_text:
「T-that can't be...! There's no way we
can win, then!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: You idiot! Don't fall for the enemy's sweet talk! We're not minnows... we're human beings!
rows.display_text:
「You idiot! Don't fall for the enemy's
sweet talk! We're not minnows... we're
human beings!」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: You've got some nerve treating us like small fry! We'll show you that small fry have their own way of fighting!
rows.display_text:
「Some nerve, treating us like small fry!
We'll show you small fry have our own
way of fighting!」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: The fact that this one has appeared before us -- is this battle also part of Special Order Code 013...?
rows.display_text:
（The fact that this one has appeared
before us -- is this battle also part of
Special Order Code 013...?）

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: If that's the case, then this machine belongs to the Federation forces too.
rows.display_text:
（If that's the case, then this machine
belongs to the Federation forces too.）

rows.en: Having another secret chat, you two? The Frost brothers?
rows.display_text:
「Having another secret chat, you two?
The Frost brothers?」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Seems you know a little about us.
rows.display_text: 「Seems you know a little about us.」

rows.en: Unfortunately, I haven't quite grasped your true aim yet.
rows.display_text:
「Unfortunately, I haven't quite grasped
your true aim yet.」

rows.en: So, some advice: abandon ambitions beyond your station before someone catches you by the tail.
rows.display_text:
「So, some advice: abandon ambitions
beyond your station before someone
catches you by the tail.」

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: What could you possibly understand about us...!
rows.display_text:
「What could you possibly understand
about us...!」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: I don't know your true identity, but at the very least, you're no ally of ours.
rows.display_text:
「I don't know your true identity, but at
the very least, you're no ally of ours.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: So we'll eliminate you...! You have no place in our world!
rows.display_text:
「So we'll eliminate you...! You have no
place in our world!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Just who are you...!? Tell me.
rows.display_text: 「Just who are you...!? Tell me.」

rows.en: There's no need to answer that. All you need to do is fight me with everything you've got.
rows.display_text:
「There's no need to answer that. All you
need to do is fight me with everything
you've got.」

rows.en: For the sake of that woman you worship.
rows.display_text:
「For the sake of that woman you
worship.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: ...In that case, I won't hold back any longer...!
rows.display_text:
「...In that case, I won't hold back any
longer...!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: If it's for General Edel's sake, I'll fight anyone, no matter who!! That's my love!!
rows.display_text:
「If it's for General Edel's sake, I'll
fight anyone, no matter who!! That's my
love!!」

rows.en: I'll fight seriously. So you should fight with everything too, Schlan.
rows.display_text:
「I'll fight seriously. So you should fight
with everything too, Schlan.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Understood. Otherwise, this task force would have no meaning.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. Otherwise, this task force
would have no meaning.」

rows.en: As expected. You understand your role properly.
rows.display_text:
「As expected. You understand your role
properly.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: I'm honored.
rows.display_text: 「I'm honored.」

rows.en: Are you angry with me? Me, who thinks even your lives are nothing but pieces on a board?
rows.display_text:
「Are you angry with me? Me, who thinks
even your lives are nothing but pieces on
a board?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: No... I'm grateful, actually. For placing me in this unit.
rows.display_text:
「No... I'm grateful, actually. For placing
me in this unit.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Right now, I'm burning with the joy of fighting alongside him.
rows.display_text:
「Right now, I'm burning with the joy of
fighting alongside him.」

rows.speaker: T-Bone
rows.en: Wh-what the hell is this guy!? He's completely overwhelming!
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what the hell is this guy!? He's
completely overwhelming!」

rows.speaker: Dove
rows.en: Let's run, boss! We can't handle something like this!
rows.display_text:
「Let's run, boss! We can't handle
something like this!」

rows.en: You should do just that. Personally, I'd feel a bit bad about wrecking that machine of yours.
rows.display_text:
「You should do just that. Personally, I'd
feel a bit bad about wrecking that
machine of yours.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Don't tell me what to do! Being talked down to makes my skin crawl!
rows.display_text:
「Don't tell me what to do! Being talked
down to makes my skin crawl!」

rows.en: Oh...? Seems you're a man who loves freedom too.
rows.display_text:
「Oh...? Seems you're a man who loves
freedom too.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: That's right! That's why I won't bow my head to some bastard I don't like!
rows.display_text:
「That's right! That's why I won't bow
my head to some bastard I don't like!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Here I come, you big lug! I'll take you on as far as I can manage!!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, you big lug! I'll take you
on as far as I can manage!!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: The Black History... the rainbow sky... butterfly wings...! Aaahh!
rows.display_text:
「The Black History... the rainbow sky...
butterfly wings...! Aaahh!」

rows.en: Could it be that you know the truth behind the Black History?
rows.display_text:
「Could it be that you know the truth
behind the Black History?」

rows.en: I'm looking into that myself. I'd like to borrow your abilities.
rows.display_text:
「I'm looking into that myself. I'd like to
borrow your abilities.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: Ah... aah...
If I can't have you, then I suppose I'll have to go to D.O.M.E. on the Moon.
rows.display_text:
「If I can't have you, then I suppose I'll
have to go to D.O.M.E. on the Moon.」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: D.O.M.E.... the forbidden land... Lady Dianna...!
rows.display_text:
「D.O.M.E.... the forbidden land... Lady
Dianna...!」

rows.speaker: Corin
rows.en: You insolent fool, daring to touch upon what's forbidden! In the name of Dianna Soreil, I will strike you down!
rows.display_text:
「You insolent fool, daring to touch upon
what's forbidden! In the name of Dianna
Soreil, I will strike you down!」

rows.en: So, unraveling the Black History does hinge on the Moon after all... Heh... just knowing that much is a great harvest.
rows.display_text:
「So, unraveling the Black History hinges
on the Moon after all... Heh... just
knowing that much is a great harvest.」

rows.en: So you're Dewey Novak's little treasure, hm?
rows.display_text:
「So you're Dewey Novak's little treasure,
hm?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: You know about Dewey!?
rows.display_text: 「You know about Dewey!?」

rows.en: Let me tell you something else while I'm at it -- just how insignificant your existence is to him.
rows.display_text:
「Let me tell you something else while
I'm at it -- just how insignificant your
existence is to him.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: I-I only believe Dewey's words...! I won't believe you!
rows.display_text:
「I-I only believe Dewey's words...! I
won't believe you!」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: I'm not listening to a word you say! Disappear! Just disappear already!!
rows.display_text:
「I'm not listening to a word you say!
Disappear! Just disappear already!!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: What is he...!? What's his goal, coming after us like this!?
rows.display_text:
「What is he...!? What's his goal, coming
after us like this!?」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Questions can wait! If we don't fight back, we're the ones who die!
rows.display_text:
「Questions can wait! If we don't fight
back, we're the ones who die!」

rows.en: That's fine resolve, Captain. A man with guts like yours is a tough one to deal with.
rows.display_text:
「That's fine resolve, Captain. A man with
guts like yours is a tough one to deal
with.」

rows.en: Now, resist with everything you've got. Otherwise, there'd be no point in my coming here.
rows.display_text:
「Now, resist with everything you've got.
Otherwise, there'd be no point in my
coming here.」

rows.speaker: Jurgens
rows.en: Don't screw with us! I'll make you regret underestimating a man of the sky!
rows.display_text:
「Don't screw with us! I'll make you
regret underestimating a man of the sky!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Tch...! My gut's screaming at how dangerous this guy is!
rows.display_text:
「Tch...! My gut's screaming at how
dangerous this guy is!」

rows.en: As expected of Timp Sharon, famous as a lone wolf. Your instinct for danger is superb.
rows.display_text:
「As expected of Timp Sharon, famous as
a lone wolf. Your instinct for danger is
superb.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: This guy's danger isn't just about how strong his machine is...!
rows.display_text:
「This guy's danger isn't just about how
strong his machine is...!」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: This bottomless creepiness... this guy's got some serious nerve!
rows.display_text:
「This bottomless creepiness... this guy's
got some serious nerve!」

rows.en: So, what will you do? Tuck your tail and run?
rows.display_text:
「So, what will you do? Tuck your tail
and run?」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Heh... true, there's no life without staying alive. That'd be the smart move, alright.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... true, there's no life without
staying alive. That'd be the smart move,
alright.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: But I'm not falling for it. You're the type who'd shoot a guy in the back without a second thought, even if he was already running.
rows.display_text:
「But I'm not falling for it. You'd shoot
a fleeing man in the back without a
second thought.」

rows.en: Correct. You really do understand well.
rows.display_text: 「Correct. You really do understand well.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Looks like the only way for me to survive is to come at you head-on...! Guess I'll have to get serious for the first time in a while!
rows.display_text:
「Looks like coming at you head-on is my
only shot at surviving...! Guess I'll finally
get serious!」

rows.speaker: Geraba
rows.en: B-boss! This guy's huge! And strong on top of that!
rows.display_text:
「B-boss! This guy's huge! And strong on
top of that!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Quit your bellyaching! Just think of it as fighting the Iron Gear!!
rows.display_text:
「Quit your bellyaching! Just think of it
as fighting the Iron Gear!!」

rows.en: Haven't you two lost to that Iron Gear over and over, though?
rows.display_text:
「Haven't you two lost to that Iron Gear
over and over, though?」

rows.speaker: Geraba
rows.en: H-he's got a point!
rows.display_text: 「H-he's got a point!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Idiot! Don't listen to a word the enemy says!
rows.display_text:
「Idiot! Don't listen to a word the enemy
says!」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Screw it, then! We're charging in like we've got nothing to lose!!
rows.display_text:
「Screw it, then! We're charging in like
we've got nothing to lose!!」

rows.en: You two are truly wonderful... living so openly by your raw emotions -- that's what freedom really is.
rows.display_text:
「You two are truly wonderful... living so
openly by your raw emotions -- that's
what freedom really is.」

rows.speaker: Edel
rows.en: ...You're saying voices of doubt about the mission have arisen within Special Task Force 013?
rows.display_text:
「...You're saying voices of doubt about
the mission have arisen within Special
Task Force 013?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Those guys, cheeky as they are, seem to have complaints about how they're being treated, nya.
rows.display_text:
「Those guys, cheeky as they are, seem
to have complaints about how they're
being treated, nya.」

rows.speaker: Edel
rows.en: How foolish, to question one's own existence... If it's meaning they want, I would gladly give it to them...
rows.display_text:
「How foolish, to question one's own
existence... If it's meaning they want, I
would gladly give it to them...」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: But it's exactly because they're such a handful that they're perfect for the test, nya.
rows.display_text:
「But it's exactly because they're such a
handful that they're perfect for the
test, nya.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Their combat strength's rising just as we intended, too. It's about time for the climax, nya.
rows.display_text:
「Their combat strength's rising just as
we intended, too. It's about time for the
climax, nya.」

rows.speaker: Edel
rows.en: So you're having Asakim fight the task force, is that it?
rows.display_text:
「So you're having Asakim fight the task
force, is that it?」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: We'll gather data on a simulated $c and gauge Asakim's power too... it's a plan that kills two birds with one stone, nya.
rows.display_text:
「We'll gather data on a simulated $c
and gauge Asakim's power too... two birds,
one stone, nya.」

rows.speaker: Edel
rows.en: Well done, Jie. Now, come back here and begin preparing for the next plan.
rows.display_text:
「Well done, Jie. Now, come back here and
begin preparing for the next plan.」

rows.speaker: Edel
rows.en: Now that we have Scirocco and Dewey as our collaborators, Chimera moves on to the next step.
rows.display_text:
「Now that we have Scirocco and Dewey
as our collaborators, Chimera moves on to
the next step.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Aww... I wanted to watch the fight between Asakim and the task force with my own eyes, nya...
rows.display_text:
「Aww... I wanted to watch the fight
between Asakim and the task force with
my own eyes, nya...」

rows.speaker: Edel
rows.en: ...Know your place, Jie.
rows.display_text: 「...Know your place, Jie.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: D-don't be so mad, nya!
rows.display_text: 「D-don't be so mad, nya!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: I loooove you~! Lady Edel... I want you to hear my request, nya.
rows.display_text:
「I loooove you~! Lady Edel... I want
you to hear my request, nya.」

rows.speaker: Edel
rows.en: Very well, Jie. I'll leave it to you.
rows.display_text: 「Very well, Jie. I'll leave it to you.」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Thank you so much, nya, Lady Edel!
rows.display_text: 「Thank you so much, nya, Lady Edel!」

rows.speaker: Jie
rows.en: Now then, Jie Babel -- let's go deliver the finishing touches, nya!
rows.display_text:
「Now then, Jie Babel -- let's go deliver
the finishing touches, nya!」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...As already informed, Special Task Force 013 will be disbanded as of today.
rows.display_text:
「...As already informed, Special Task
Force 013 will be disbanded as of today.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Members who aren't military personnel will be returning to their respective affiliations.
rows.display_text:
「Members who aren't military personnel
will be returning to their respective
affiliations.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: ...I can't say I'm satisfied, but I suppose it can't be helped...
rows.display_text:
「...I can't say I'm satisfied, but I
suppose it can't be helped...」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Come to think of it, what happened to Corin Nander? I don't see him around...
rows.display_text:
「Come to think of it, what happened to
Corin Nander? I don't see him around...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: That guy hopped out of his machine and ran off the moment the fight ended.
rows.display_text:
「That guy hopped out of his machine and
ran off the moment the fight ended.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: He was going on about the Black History or something, but the guy's screws were completely loose.
rows.display_text:
「He was going on about the Black
History or something, but the guy's
screws were completely loose.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: That man, Corin... does he know about the Black History...?
rows.display_text:
（That man, Corin... does he know about
the Black History...?）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Well, never mind. Given the state he's in, I doubt he'd leak anything classified.
rows.display_text:
「Well, never mind. Given the state he's
in, I doubt he'd leak anything classified.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: I appreciate everything, Captain. Whatever we were used for, this unit... wasn't such a bad place to be.
rows.display_text:
「I appreciate everything, Captain.
Whatever we were used for, this unit...
wasn't such a bad place to be.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Hearing you say that makes me glad, as your commander. I'm grateful for all your cooperation.
rows.display_text:
「Hearing you say that makes me glad, as
your commander. I'm grateful for all your
cooperation.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Let's hurry home, Asuham. I'm sure Lord Kizz is waiting for us too.
rows.display_text:
「Let's hurry home, Asuham. I'm sure Lord
Kizz is waiting for us too.」

rows.speaker: Kejinan
rows.en: Looks like we'll make it home safe somehow, and if we get that special bonus for completing the mission, I've got nothing left to complain about.

rows.speaker: Enge
rows.en: While they're at it, I hope they restore the rank we got demoted from too.
rows.display_text:
「While they're at it, I hope they
restore the rank we got demoted from
too.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Cynthia...
rows.display_text: 「Cynthia...」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: What?
rows.display_text: 「What?」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Are you fighting for the sake of that Lord Kizz person you mentioned earlier?
rows.display_text:
「Are you fighting for the sake of that
Lord Kizz person you mentioned earlier?」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Y-yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Take care... We probably won't see each other again, though.
rows.display_text:
「Take care... We probably won't see each
other again, though.」

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: You too. ...I'm glad we met, Anemone.
rows.display_text: 「You too. ...I'm glad we met, Anemone.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Yeah.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Anemone. We're going back to Federation HQ.
rows.display_text:
「Anemone. We're going back to Federation
HQ.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: HQ...! Then, does that mean...!?
rows.display_text: 「HQ...! Then, does that mean...!?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Yeah, that's right. You'll get to see Colonel Dewey soon.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, that's right. You'll get to see
Colonel Dewey soon.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Dewey's coming...! Dewey's coming to see me!
rows.display_text:
「Dewey's coming...! Dewey's coming to see
me!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: But you know, Anemone... that's also the beginning of our true fight...
rows.display_text:
（But you know, Anemone... that's also
the beginning of our true fight...）

rows.speaker: Geraba
rows.en: ...Still, too bad, boss. Your scheme to worm your way into the Federation's good graces didn't pan out.
rows.display_text:
「...Still, too bad, boss. Your scheme to
worm your way into the Federation's good
graces didn't pan out.」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Nah... this whole thing taught me a lesson. I don't think I can keep up with how the military does things.
rows.display_text:
「Nah... this whole thing taught me a
lesson. I don't think I can keep up with
how the military does things.」

rows.speaker: Hola
rows.en: Seems like the higher-ups think the lives of the guys fighting on the front line are worth about as much as paper.
rows.display_text:
「Seems the higher-ups think front-line
soldiers' lives are worth about as much
as paper.」

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Naive, droopy-eyes. Whether it's the military or Sibe Rail, soldiers are pawns everywhere -- that never changes.
rows.display_text:
（Naive, droopy-eyes. Military or Sibe
Rail, soldiers are pawns everywhere --
that never changes.）

rows.speaker: Timp
rows.en: Well... I got my fill of the military too. Seems the Earth Federation Forces is a way more troublesome place than I imagined.
rows.display_text:
（I've had my fill of the military too.
Earth Federation Forces are far more
trouble than expected.）

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: Beck... if it's fine with you, I could set you up with a job.
rows.display_text:
「Beck... if it's fine with you, I could
set you up with a job.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Sorry to disappoint, boss. ...Now that I've gotten a decent payout, busting my ass at work is the last thing I want.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry to disappoint, boss. ...Now I've
got a decent payout, busting my ass at
work is the last thing I want.」

rows.speaker: Asuham
rows.en: I see... That's a shame.
rows.display_text: 「I see... That's a shame.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Well... I don't dislike you, boss. Give me a call whenever you're heading into a real fight.
rows.display_text:
「Well... I don't dislike you, boss. Give
me a call whenever you're heading into a
real fight.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I'm planning to give the Beck the Great RX3 a total overhaul. I'll come running in a shiny new model.
rows.display_text:
「I'm planning to give the Beck the Great
RX3 a total overhaul. I'll come running in
a shiny new model.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Orders have come in individually for the military personnel. Everyone, go ahead and receive yours.
rows.display_text:
「Orders have come in individually for the
military personnel. Everyone, go ahead and
receive yours.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Understood, Captain.
rows.display_text: 「Understood, Captain.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Captain Lowen and the others are returning to Chimera, huh...
rows.display_text:
「Captain Lowen and the others are
returning to Chimera, huh...」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Yes... I'll take what I've learned here and give my all to my duties with Chimera.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... I'll take what I've learned here
and give my all to my duties with
Chimera.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: So me, Kacricon, and Mouar are under Colonel Scirocco for the new model's final testing, huh...
rows.display_text:
「So me, Kacricon, and Mouar are under
Colonel Scirocco for the new model's final
testing, huh...」

rows.speaker: Auel
rows.en: Alright! We're with Phantom Pain, chasing down the rumored $c!
rows.display_text:
「Alright! We're with Phantom Pain,
chasing down the rumored $c!」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Ensign Rosamia, Ensign Four, and I are being reassigned there as well.
rows.display_text:
「Ensign Rosamia, Ensign Four, and I are
being reassigned there as well.」

rows.speaker: Sting
rows.en: You too, Major Bran...!?
rows.display_text: 「You too, Major Bran...!?」

rows.speaker: Bran
rows.en: Don't act like that's a bad thing. There's still combat technique I haven't finished teaching you two.
rows.display_text:
「Don't act like that's a bad thing.
There's still combat technique I haven't
finished teaching you two.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Too bad, Lt. Jerid. But you and the others will likely be assigned to this unit eventually too.
rows.display_text:
「Too bad, Lt. Jerid. But you and the
others will likely be assigned to this unit
eventually too.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Captain...
rows.display_text: 「Captain...」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: $c is a tough opponent... Chances are, even Major Bran and I will find ourselves struggling.
rows.display_text:
「$c is a tough opponent... Chances are,
even Major Bran and I will find ourselves
struggling.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: I'll be waiting for you all, Lieutenants.
rows.display_text: 「I'll be waiting for you all, Lieutenants.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Understood. I wish you good fortune in battle.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. I wish you good fortune in
battle.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Jerid...
rows.display_text: 「Jerid...」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Mouar... once the new model's testing is done, I'm planning to volunteer for the $c pursuit unit.
rows.display_text:
「Mouar... once the new model's testing is
done, I'm planning to volunteer for the
$c pursuit unit.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: I'll come with you, Jerid. To watch your back.
rows.display_text:
「I'll come with you, Jerid. To watch your
back.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Mouar...
rows.display_text: 「Mouar...」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Supporting you as you move forward -- that's my fight, starting today.
rows.display_text:
「Supporting you as you move forward --
that's my fight, starting today.」

rows.speaker: Mouar
rows.en: Remember this, Jerid. From now on, I'll always be right by your side.
rows.display_text:
「Remember this, Jerid. From now on, I'll
always be right by your side.」

rows.speaker: Kacricon
rows.en: It's not just Mouar, Jerid. Don't forget I'm here too.
rows.display_text:
「It's not just Mouar, Jerid. Don't forget
I'm here too.」

rows.speaker: Jerid
rows.en: Yeah...! I'm counting on both of you.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...! I'm counting on both of you.」

rows.speaker: Rosamia
rows.en: We're together again, Stella.
rows.display_text: 「We're together again, Stella.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Yeah...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Hey, Stella... why were you kind to me back then?
rows.display_text:
「Hey, Stella... why were you kind to me
back then?」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: ...Because you looked like you were in pain...
rows.display_text:
「...Because you looked like you were in
pain...」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Neo told me... to help a comrade when they're in trouble.
rows.display_text:
「Neo told me... to help a comrade when
they're in trouble.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Thank you.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you.」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: But I don't just want to be with you when things are hard, Stella... I want to be with you when things are happy and fun too...
rows.display_text:
「I don't just want to be with you when
it's hard, Stella... I want that when
happy and fun too...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: I want to be friends with you, Stella.
rows.display_text: 「I want to be friends with you, Stella.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Friends...
rows.display_text: 「Friends...」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: Yeah.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: What are friends...? Is it okay to be together if you're friends?
rows.display_text:
「What are friends...? Is it okay to be
together if you're friends?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: That's right. So you can share the happy things and the sad things together.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. So you can share the
happy things and the sad things together.」

rows.speaker: Stella
rows.en: Is it okay to have someone like that, besides Sting and Auel?
rows.display_text:
「Is it okay to have someone like that,
besides Sting and Auel?」

rows.speaker: Four
rows.en: It's okay. That's exactly what friends are.
rows.display_text:
「It's okay. That's exactly what friends
are.」

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: Now that's a heartwarming sight.
rows.display_text: （Now that's a heartwarming sight.）

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: An Enhanced Human and an Extended... Seems like two people of similar circumstance were drawn to each other.
rows.display_text:
（An Enhanced Human and an Extended...
Seems like two people of similar
circumstance were drawn to each other.）

rows.speaker: Shagia
rows.en: But we're different... Even in this world, it's just the two of us... no comrades, no friends.
rows.display_text:
（But we're different... Even in this
world, it's just the two of us... no
comrades, no friends.）

rows.speaker: Olba
rows.en: My brother and me... we don't acknowledge any existence beyond that.
rows.display_text:
（My brother and me... we don't
acknowledge any existence beyond that.）

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: ...Special Task Force 013 is disbanded as of today. And, given its classification level of AAA, this unit's existence will be treated as though it never was.
rows.display_text:
「...Special Task Force 013 disbands
today. Given AAA class, this unit never
existed, officially.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: But even though it was a short time, I believe this unit left something behind in each of you.
rows.display_text:
「But even though it was a short time, I
believe this unit left something behind in
each of you.」

rows.speaker: Neo
rows.en: Even if the records are erased, don't any of you forget it. That's all... Well done, everyone.
rows.display_text:
「Even if the records are erased, don't
any of you forget it. That's all... Well
done, everyone.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: ...Schlan. Did you hear anything about what happened today?
rows.display_text:
「...Schlan. Did you hear anything about
what happened today?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: No... but I have a rough idea of how things went.
rows.display_text:
「No... but I have a rough idea of how
things went.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: As you know, that thing is the trump card Dr. Jie has been developing for Chimera.
rows.display_text:
「As you know, that thing is the trump
card Dr. Jie has been developing for
Chimera.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Special Task Force 013 was likely chosen to be its test opponent.
rows.display_text:
「Special Task Force 013 was likely
chosen to be its test opponent.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: But, not even telling us about it...
rows.display_text: 「But, not even telling us about it...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: That's just how the doctor is. To satisfy his own curiosity, even our lives probably mean nothing to him.
rows.display_text:
「That's just how the doctor is. To
satisfy his own curiosity, even our lives
probably mean nothing to him.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Then who was piloting that thing? The voice was disguised, but...
rows.display_text:
「Then who was piloting that thing? The
voice was disguised, but...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Someone the doctor arranged. There's no need for us to know.
rows.display_text:
「Someone the doctor arranged. There's no
need for us to know.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Not satisfied?
rows.display_text: 「Not satisfied?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Of course not...! I've dedicated everything to General Edel!
rows.display_text:
「Of course not...! I've dedicated
everything to General Edel!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: I can't afford to lose my life over anything but General Edel's orders!
rows.display_text:
「I can't afford to lose my life over
anything but General Edel's orders!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: That's your strength, isn't it.
rows.display_text: 「That's your strength, isn't it.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: That's probably exactly why the doctor kept the test's details from us and had it attack us in earnest -- to draw out your strength.
rows.display_text:
「That's probably why the doctor hid the
test's details and had it attack us in
earnest -- to draw out your strength.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: For the sake of your strength -- the strength of a man willing to stake his life for General Edel.
rows.display_text:
「For the sake of your strength -- the
strength of a man willing to stake his
life for General Edel.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: That's fine by me...! But because of that, even you got dragged into danger...
rows.display_text:
「That's fine by me...! But because of
that, even you got dragged into danger...」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Don't worry about it, Lowen. As long as I'm with you, I won't die so easily.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry about it, Lowen. As long as
I'm with you, I won't die so easily.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Schlan...!
rows.display_text: 「Schlan...!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: We've got our next mission lined up too. ...Seems the matter in Japan is about to be settled as well.
rows.display_text:
「We've got our next mission lined up
too. ...Seems the matter in Japan is about
to be settled as well.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: We're to head to Japan too and make contact with $c.
rows.display_text:
「We're to head to Japan too and make
contact with $c.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: I see... So it's finally time for us to start moving too.
rows.display_text:
「I see... So it's finally time for us to
start moving too.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Does your blood boil?
rows.display_text: 「Does your blood boil?」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Yeah...! Because the time has come to use my strength for General Edel's ideals!
rows.display_text:
「Yeah...! Because the time has come to
use my strength for General Edel's ideals!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Once the plan moves to its next stage, you'll act alongside $c and take on the role of guiding them from within.
rows.display_text:
「Once the plan moves ahead, you'll act
alongside $c, guiding them from within.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: If that happens, you'll end up fighting former Special Task Force 013 members chasing $c too...
rows.display_text:
「If that happens, you'll end up fighting
former Special Task Force 013 members
chasing $c too...」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: I don't care if they report me as a traitor!
rows.display_text:
「I don't care if they report me as a
traitor!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: For General Edel's sake, I'll accept any disgrace! I don't even mind dying!
rows.display_text:
「For General Edel's sake, I'll accept any
disgrace! I don't even mind dying!」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: That's fine... After all, that's your strength.
rows.display_text:
「That's fine... After all, that's your
strength.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: But there's no need to worry. Most of Special Task Force 013's members are actually under Scirocco and Dewey.
rows.display_text:
「But there's no need to worry. Most of
Special Task Force 013's members are
actually under Scirocco and Dewey.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: Word just came in. It seems General Edel has joined forces with those two.
rows.display_text:
「Word just came in. It seems General
Edel has joined forces with those two.」

rows.speaker: Schlan
rows.en: In order to reform the New Earth Federation from within.
rows.display_text:
「In order to reform the New Earth
Federation from within.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: General Edel...! Your ideal world is almost here. I'll dedicate my life to it too...!
rows.display_text:
「General Edel...! Your ideal world is
almost here. I'll dedicate my life to it
too...!」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: Wait for it, $c...! You're all going to work for General Edel's sake.
rows.display_text:
「Wait for it, $c...! You're all going to
work for General Edel's sake.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: And once you've served your purpose, I'll be the one to tear you to shreds from the inside...!
rows.display_text:
「And once you've served your purpose,
I'll be the one to tear you to shreds
from the inside...!」
